mapper.select: SELECT T1.CD_GROUP , T1.CD_GROUP_NM , T2.CD_VAL , T2.CD_NM , T2.CD_DESC , T2.LNUP_SER , T2.UZ_YN FROM OCUOC_CCGRP_M T1 LEFT OUTER JOIN OCUOC_CCDTL_L T2 ON T1.CD_GROUP = T2.CD_GROUP WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY CD_GROUP, LNUP_SER
SELECT CD_VAL , CD_NM FROM OCUOC_CCDTL_L WHERE 1=1 AND CD_GROUP = #{groupCd} AND UZ_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY LNUP_SER

SELECT T1.EMPNO , T1.EMP_KOR_FLNM , T1.BLNG_BRCD , T1.BSORGCD , T1.EMP_JOBCLS_CD , T1.HRA_PSTN_CD , T1.HRA_PSTN_NM , T2.BR_NM FROM OCUOC_USERI_M T1 INNER JOIN OCUOC_DPRMI_M T2 ON T1.BLNG_BRCD = T2.BR_CD WHERE 1=1
AND T1.EMP_KOR_FLNM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND T2.BR_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY T1.EMP_KOR_FLNM, T1.EMPNO
FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT MENU_ID AS menuId , MENU_NM AS menuNm , UPRN_MENU_ID AS uprnMenuId , MENU_URL AS menuUrl FROM OCUOC_MENUN_M WHERE 1=1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND MENU_LEVEL = 2

/* 최초 메뉴 조회 commonMenuList */ select M.MENU_ID as menuId , M.MENU_NM as menuNm , M.MENU_LEVEL as menuLevel , M.UPRN_MENU_ID as uprnMenuId , (SELECT MENU_NM FROM OCUOC_MENUN_M WHERE MENU_ID = M.UPRN_MENU_ID) AS uprnMenuNm , M.MENU_SER as menuSer , M.MENU_URL as menuUrl , M.USE_YN as useYn , M.LAST_CHNG_EMPNO as lastChngEmpno , M.LAST_CHNG_DTTM as lastChngDttm from OCUOC_MENUN_M m where M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (#{userId} = 'TEST' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OCUOC_USERI_M UM WHERE UM.EMPNO = #{userId}) ) and (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OCUOC_USROL_R R JOIN OCUOC_ROLEM_M RM ON RM.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID join OCUOC_USMUA_R U on R.ROLE_ID = U.ROLE_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND U.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND RM.USE_YN = 'Y' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM OCUOC_USROL_R R JOIN OCUOC_ROLEM_M RM ON RM.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID join OCUOC_USMUA_R U on R.ROLE_ID = U.ROLE_ID JOIN OCUOC_MENUN_M C ON C.MENU_ID = U.MENU_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' AND RM.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.UPRN_MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID) ) START WITH M.MENU_LEVEL = 1 CONNECT BY PRIOR M.MENU_ID = M.UPRN_MENU_ID order SIBLINGS BY M.MENU_SER

/* 최초 버튼권한 조회 commonRoleButtonList */ SELECT DISTINCT B.BTN_CD AS btnCd ,B.BTN_NM AS btnNm ,B.AREA_CD AS areaCd ,B.ACTION_CD AS actionCd ,B.IOCN_URL AS iocnUrl ,B.MENU_ID AS menuId ,B.BTN_SEQ AS btnSeq FROM OCUOC_USROL_R A JOIN OCUOC_ROLEM_M R ON A.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID join ocuoc_USBTN_m U on a.ROLE_ID = U.ROLE_ID join ocuoc_buttn_m B on U.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID and U.BTN_CD = B.BTN_CD where A.USER_ID = #{userId} and A.USE_YN = 'Y' and U.USE_YN = 'Y' and B.USE_YN = 'Y' and R.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.BTN_SEQ

/* 최초 사용자정보 조회 selectUserInfo */ select A.EMPNO AS userId , A.EMP_KOR_FLNM AS userName , A.BLNG_BRCD AS deptCode , B.BR_NM AS deptName from OCUOC_USERI_M A JOIN OCUOC_DPRMI_M B ON A.BLNG_BRCD = B.BR_CD where 1=1 and A.EMPNO = #{userId}
